channel.title: Daily AI News
channel.description: Twice-daily AI news briefing produced by the daily-ai-news Copilot skill.

item.title: OpenAI ships major Codex update with Appshots and long-running goal mode
item.description: OpenAI’s May 21 Codex release adds macOS Appshots, productionized Goal mode, remote computer use, plugin sharing, and Codex CLI 0.133.0.

item.title: ChatGPT for PowerPoint enters beta
item.description: OpenAI has introduced a ChatGPT add-in for Microsoft PowerPoint that can create and edit presentations from prompts and source material.

item.title: Alibaba releases Qwen3.7-Max for long-cycle agent workflows
item.description: Alibaba launched Qwen3.7-Max, a flagship agent foundation model focused on stable, long-running enterprise workflows.

item.title: Microsoft introduces Plan agent in Visual Studio
item.description: Microsoft added a Plan agent to Visual Studio so Copilot can explore, clarify, draft, and refine implementation plans before changing code.

item.title: RoPeSLR speeds up long video generation with sparse-low-rank attention
item.description: A new arXiv paper proposes RoPeSLR, a 3D RoPE-guided sparse-low-rank attention framework for efficient diffusion-transformer video generation.

item.title: MONET releases a 104.9M-pair open text-to-image dataset
item.description: MONET introduces an Apache 2.0 dataset of about 104.9 million curated image-text pairs for reproducible text-to-image research.

item.title: RAEv2 reports 10× faster convergence for representation autoencoders
item.description: RAEv2 improves representation autoencoders for image generation, reporting state-of-the-art gFID results with much faster convergence.

item.title: Anthropic reportedly projects first profitable quarter
item.description: CNBC reported that Anthropic expects Q2 revenue to reach $10.9 billion and could post its first operating profit.

item.title: Reuters says OpenAI is preparing for a possible IPO filing
item.description: Reuters reported that OpenAI is preparing to confidentially file for a U.S. IPO, potentially targeting a valuation as high as $1 trillion.

item.title: Google AI Overviews are breaking simple dictionary-style searches
item.description: 9to5Google reported that Google AI Overviews can misread words like “disregard,” “ignore,” and “dismiss” as instructions instead of dictionary queries.

item.title: Grok struggles to show meaningful U.S. government adoption
item.description: The Verge, citing Reuters, reported that xAI’s Grok appeared in only three named examples across more than 400 U.S. government AI-use records reviewed.

item.title: Trump delays AI executive order over concerns about slowing innovation
item.description: USA Today reported that President Trump abruptly halted plans to sign an AI executive order hours before a scheduled ceremony.

item.title: Google DeepMind launches APAC “AI for the Planet” accelerator
item.description: Google DeepMind launched a three-month accelerator in Asia-Pacific for startups, research teams, and nonprofits using frontier AI on environmental risks.
